## Reader reliability

- Pending TCP segments and unresolved gaps are bounded so packet reassembly cannot grow indefinitely during long sessions.
- Capture batches yield regularly to status updates, connection discovery and stop commands.
- A watchdog exits a reader that makes no progress for 30 seconds. The app replaces the worker automatically.
- Data folders are resolved to their canonical location before opening SQLite, including folders moved through Windows junctions.

A stream with missing data is invalidated rather than guessing packet contents or keeping an unverified identity. After a reader replacement, enter your character again when safe so Waymark can identify the session and resync supported pet observations. Previously saved progress and settings remain intact; pickups missed during a capture gap are not invented.
